supersedes: stage3a_v2_final (preserved, frozen — GELU architecture mismatched to its weights)
changes_from_v2f: ARCHITECTURE_CORRECTION_ONLY — model changed from 'ViT-B-16' (GELU default in open_clip 3.3.0; no quick_gelu field) to 'ViT-B-16-quickgelu' (quick_gelu=true), matching the official OpenAI weight definition (timm/vit_base_patch16_clip_224.openai open_clip_config.json declares quick_gelu=true; weights sha256 4b869929...). Approved by ChatGPT 2026-10-23 based on the weight's official architecture, NOT on observed accuracy. All other protocol elements, chains, evaluators, reference rules and completeness rules are unchanged from v2-final. New markers/producer/manifest path/CSV names prevent mixing with frozen v2-final results.
purpose: STAGE3A MVTec controlled normality-model family comparison — final corrected portable runner. MVTec only; VisA NOT included; no E2 formal timing claim.

authorization.stage3a_mvtec: CONDITIONALLY_AUTHORIZED FOR QUICKGELU RERUN (ChatGPT, 2026-10-23); GPU runs gated on CPU tests, QuickGELU activation verification and user-confirmed GPU price

dataset.name: mvtec_ad
dataset.test_split: all test images (good + all defect types) with GT masks; image-mask pairing verified at load AND in the data signature
dataset.reference_rule: train/good, src.dataset sorted() path order, first <=50

model.name: ViT-B-16-quickgelu
model.official_source: timm/vit_base_patch16_clip_224.openai (Hugging Face repo); open_clip_config.json declares quick_gelu=true; OpenAI CLIP ViT was trained with QuickGELU
model.architecture_correction_reason: The plain 'ViT-B-16' config in open_clip 3.3.0 has no quick_gelu field (GELU default) and pretrained-tag checks only warn; using it with OpenAI QuickGELU weights is architecture-mismatched. v3f uses 'ViT-B-16-quickgelu' which matches the official weight definition. Decision based on the pretrained model's original definition, not on accuracy.
model.pretrained_source: local offline safetensors ONLY (no network downloads)
model.weights_hash_policy: sha256 MUST equal expected at preflight; mismatch forbids run AND resume reuse
model.feature: 196 patch tokens, D=512, proj applied, L2-normalized
model.weight_identity_note: weights identical to the frozen 4b869929... file used by all prior Stage3A/3B runs; only the model config (GELU -> QuickGELU) changed
model.legacy_gelu_results: stage3a_v2_final MVTec 75-record results are PRESERVED FROZEN but are architecture-mismatched historical reference (GELU model + QuickGELU weights); they must not be blended with QuickGELU results

formal_completeness_guard.complete_standard: ALWAYS the frozen 15 categories x 5 chains = 75 unique valid records
formal_completeness_guard.subset_rule: --categories / --category produce PARTIAL runs only; expectations are NEVER relaxed to the run subset
checks: exact chain-set equality per category (missing AND unexpected chains fail)
formal_completeness_guard.partial_policy: partial results retained for recovery but status CANNOT be COMPLETE; final CSV stays *_PARTIAL.csv until 75/75 valid

resume_integrity.data_signature_v2: content-level SHA256 over: every normal reference image, every normal test image, every defect test image with its EXPLICIT paired mask (4-tuple), using dataset-relative POSIX paths; data_root excluded from the hash (machine-independent)
resume_integrity.no_backfill_rule: if formal records exist but run_fingerprint.json is missing -> resume REFUSED (exit 5); fingerprints are never backfilled for unknown-origin results
resume_integrity.non_resume_overwrite: refused (exit 5) when formal records already exist; use a NEW --output-dir
resume_integrity.smoke_formal_isolation: separate output subtrees and distinct markers; smoke records are never read as formal results

normalization_safety.behavior: STOP (SCIENTIFIC_SAFETY_STOP, exit 4); evidence (category/chain/min/max/range) written to SAFETY_STOP_REPORT.json; degenerate zeroed maps never recorded as success
normalization_safety.outside_01_policy: test normalized scores outside [0,1] are informational counts only, NOT failures

timing_boundary_v2.label: PRELIMINARY_DIAGNOSTIC
timing_boundary_v2.scorer_only_note: test_scoring_s is scorer-only on cached features but single-run; formal E2 needs pre-registered repeats/warmup/CUDA-sync

resource_guard.wallclock_semantics: cumulative wall-clock (incl. preflight/model setup) checked before each category; breach -> exit 4 WALLCLOCK_BUDGET stop with partial results kept
resource_guard.rmb_budget_note: the pre-approved GPU budget CANNOT be auto-enforced by software; the user MUST verify actual charges in the GPU provider console; this runner claims no billing protection

definitions.CostDifference(N): DeltaP - N * DeltaS (N>=0 real; integer meaning = images scored per category)

regimes: CROSSOVER (DeltaP>0,DeltaS>0): Nearest low-load, VNE above N*=DeltaP/DeltaS
CROSSOVER (DeltaP<0,DeltaS<0): VNE low-load, Nearest above N*=DeltaP/DeltaS
DeltaS=0 boundary: no division; dominance by sign of DeltaP; both zero -> IDENTICAL
DeltaP=0 boundary: no division; strict dominance for N>0 by sign of DeltaS
INDETERMINATE: CI of DeltaP or DeltaS spans zero
break_even_classification_v2.integer_semantics: first_strict_N = floor(N*)+1; tie exactly at integer N=N*

stop_conditions: non-finite or degenerate normalization (exit 4, evidence kept)
completeness guard failure -> INCOMPLETE (partial kept; never COMPLETE)
GPU access/price precondition unmet -> user stops, reports BLOCKED (no self-authorized workaround)

required_files_on_target_machine.this_dir: final_patch/ (runner v2-final + manifest v2-final + regression tests)
